component.summary: Vader. The AI-native IDE for agents you can trust.

description.p: Vader is an AI-native IDE with a real coding agent (files, terminal, browser, MCP, sub-agents), a hard policy engine that sits in front of every action, and a privacy-first design with no telemetry. Bring your own model: cloud providers or local ones such as Ollama. See https://github.com/qwzx4893-stack/Vader for downloads and documentation.
